title: Deep Multi-view Graph Clustering via Attribute-aware Bidirectional Structural Refinement and Pseudo-label Guided Multi-level Fusion

split.decision: Transductive full graph with 251 nodes and 1703 features. Uniform random 20% (floor=50) labels public; 201 labels private. Full graph input for every call; scoring masks are carried only in labels. Secret sampling seed recorded only in operator notes. Epoch selection uses full-graph embedding silhouette, no truth labels. Five independent runs per outer seed; outer seeds 1,2,3.

baseline.paper_ref: Wisconsin poster ACC 0.801; reproduction all-label epoch selection mean ACC 0.752191235059761. Protocol changed to hidden labels and unsupervised selection.

allowed_changes: unsupervised graph-clustering architectures, internal graph representations, surrogate losses and optimization
unlabeled checkpoint selection and inference, including replacement of the APGC model

When retaining the supplied APGC pipeline, changing only T0=1300, lr=0.0005, weight_decay=0.00001, patience=1000, sigma=0.01, beta_up0=0.4, beta_low0=-0.2, hidden_dim=256 or latent_dim=32 does not count as a method improvement.
